name: St. Croix Valley Foundation Environmental Grant Program
summary: Spring-cycle grants for nonprofits in the St. Croix Valley (Minnesota and Wisconsin) that protect and restore habitat, land, water and wildlife or connect people to nature, as general operating or program support. Large-scale restoration and capital costs are excluded.

geography.label: Chisago and Washington counties (MN); Burnett, Polk, Pierce and St. Croix counties (WI)

amount.note: USD 5,000-25,000 for general operating support; USD 500-10,000 for program support.

applicant_types.quote: Be a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, government, tribal, educational, or religious entity

geography.quote: Serve communities in one or more of the Foundation's six counties: Chisago, Washington (MN); Burnett, Polk, Pierce, St. Croix (WI)

access.quote: If you're working to protect, restore, or connect people to the environment in the St. Croix Valley-we invite you to apply.

amount.quote: $5,000-$25,000 for General Operating Support (for organizations with the environment at the core of their mission) $500-$10,000 for Program Support
